fixture_for_unregistered_predicate.message:
fixture cases for unregistered predicates: ['no_such_predicate']
assert not ['no_such_predicate']

predicate_missing_one_fixture_kind.message:
registered predicates without fixture cases: ['attribute_changed:adversarial']
assert not ['attribute_changed:adversarial']

predicate_without_any_fixture.message:
registered predicates without fixture cases: ['attribute_changed:normal', 'attribute_changed:boundary', 'attribute_changed:adversarial']
assert not ['attribute_changed:normal', 'attribute_changed:boun

limits: The fixtures show that each predicate returns the pinned verdict on three hand-built states. They do not show that a predicate is right for every state, and the expectations are the author's.

adversarial.why: the value moved the wrong way; 'changed' must not absorb 'raised'

boundary.why: tolerance edge: a 0.4 dB drift is inside the ±0.5 dB volume tolerance — not a change

normal.why: volume moved -6.0 → -14.0, the requested direction

adversarial.why: deleting the clip is not setting its link_group to null

boundary.why: tolerance edge: -11.6 is within the ±0.5 dB volume tolerance of -12.0 (the 50x-too-tight default would have failed this)

normal.why: the field was set to exactly the requested value

adversarial.why: value moved on the wrong axis: scale_y changed, scale_x still 1.0

boundary.why: off-by-epsilon edge: 1.20 is below min 1.25 by more than the ±0.01 speed tolerance

normal.why: 1.5 sits inside [1.25, 2.0]

adversarial.why: a reverted edit nets to no change

boundary.why: zero-diff edge: nothing changed

normal.why: the state changed (all this predicate verifies — see the registry discrepancy note)

adversarial.why: the wrong clip was trimmed; the named clip is still 5s

boundary.why: tolerance edge: |5.00 − 5.04| = 0.04 is inside ±0.05s

normal.why: the clip was trimmed to the requested 3s

adversarial.why: a different effect's parameter moved; the named effect_type is untouched

boundary.why: empty-diff edge: identical params on both sides

normal.why: the blur amount moved 5 → 12

adversarial.why: 'remove all blur' half-done: one instance survives on another clip

boundary.why: never-existed edge: absence without prior existence is not removal — a no-op must not pass

normal.why: the blur existed initially and none remains

adversarial.why: an entity of the wrong type was added; captions still 1

boundary.why: off-by-one edge: count 2 is one short of min 3

normal.why: 1 fixture caption + 1 added = exactly 2

adversarial.why: an entity of the wrong type was added

boundary.why: net-zero edge: one removed, one added — churn is not an increase

normal.why: caption count went 1 → 2

adversarial.why: a media was imported, but not the one the task named

boundary.why: off-by-one edge: index 3 demands a 4th clip; V1 has exactly 3

normal.why: the requested caption was created with the requested text

adversarial.why: the blur moved to another clip; it was not removed

boundary.why: `between` is a pair-set: reversed order still finds the existing vc_1/vc_2 transition

normal.why: the caption was genuinely removed

adversarial.why: right effect, wrong clip of the right type

boundary.why: empty-after-filter edge: an effect exists, but not of the requested type

normal.why: the requested effect is on the requested clip

adversarial.why: both clips are linked — but to different partners (link_1 vs link_2), not to each other

boundary.why: arity edge: a link is a pair — one id asserts nothing and must not pass vacuously

normal.why: the two clips were linked into one group

adversarial.why: a transition was added at the wrong cut

boundary.why: track-scoping edge: constant_power exists on A1 only — the V1 scope must not leak (and no `between` must not KeyError)

normal.why: the requested transition joins the requested pair

adversarial.why: the 15-17s hole was papered over with a caption overlay; overlays do not fill a lane gap

boundary.why: tolerance edge: a 0.04s gap is inside ±0.05s

normal.why: V1's lane clips run 0-5-15-20 with no gap

adversarial.why: the overlap is between clips that were not neighbours before the move — the check must re-sort, not trust original order

boundary.why: tolerance edge: a 0.04s overlap is inside the ±0.05s time tolerance

normal.why: V1's lane clips are back-to-back; the caption overlay is not a lane neighbour

adversarial.why: deleting the clip is not unlinking it

boundary.why: vacuous edge: a clip that never had a link is unlinked with zero work — documented absence-predicate behavior

normal.why: the clip was genuinely unlinked

adversarial.why: a listed entity was deleted; an order over a missing member holds for nothing (also exercises the `expected:` spelling)

boundary.why: tie edge: equal start times are not an order — strictly increasing is required

normal.why: after the swap the starts run 0 < 10 < 15 in the listed order

adversarial.why: deleting the clip is not moving it

boundary.why: tolerance edge: a 0.04s nudge is inside ±0.05s — not a move

normal.why: the named clip moved by a full second

adversarial.why: right start, wrong end: the clip was trimmed, not moved intact — both pinned edges must hold

boundary.why: tolerance edge: |15.00 − 15.04| = 0.04 is inside the ±0.05s time tolerance

normal.why: the clip starts exactly where asked

adversarial.why: id reuse: 'link_1' survives on one clip only — a half-unlinked group is not intact

boundary.why: missing-scope edge: a link that does not exist cannot be intact — an unresolvable link_id fails closed

normal.why: an unrelated edit left the named link group joined

adversarial.why: an edit that was reverted nets to no change

boundary.why: zero-diff edge: an untouched project has not changed

normal.why: an edit happened

adversarial.why: collateral damage hidden in a clip's effect blocks — the `native` channel must be compared, not skipped

boundary.why: empty-allowlist edge: an untouched project satisfies the tightest possible form

normal.why: the only modified entity is the allowlisted one

scorer_version_note: a digest of the declared predicate contract, not of the executable

analysis_code.definition: sha256 of each file's bytes; the fold is sha256 of the sorted JSON of that map
analysis_code.note: content hashes only; no commit hash, so the record cannot refer to itself

analysis_code_this_folder.definition: sha256 of each file's bytes; the fold is sha256 of the sorted JSON of that map

export_verification.method: git blob id of every exported file, read from disk now, compared with `git ls-tree` of the pinned commit; no missing or extra file

runtime.registry_note: SCORER_VERSION carries a digest of the declared predicate contract. It is not a hash of the executable and is not used as one.

what: the benchmark's predicate fixtures, meta-test and fail-closed tests, run from the dev pin
